desktop_sessions.name: GNOME
desktop_sessions.notes: Full desktop environment; requires a compatible Linux userland, session services and display host.

desktop_sessions.name: Xfce
desktop_sessions.notes: Traditional lightweight desktop profile; X11 session target.

desktop_sessions.name: Cinnamon
desktop_sessions.notes: Integrated desktop with a traditional panel and window workflow.

desktop_sessions.name: MATE
desktop_sessions.notes: Traditional desktop profile with a lightweight session stack.

desktop_sessions.name: LXQt
desktop_sessions.notes: Modular Qt desktop; actual display support depends on the selected window manager and session.

desktop_sessions.name: Budgie
desktop_sessions.notes: Desktop shell and session integration are separate from the compositor backend.

desktop_sessions.name: Pantheon
desktop_sessions.notes: Integrated desktop profile with Gala window management.

desktop_sessions.name: Deepin Desktop Environment
desktop_sessions.notes: Desktop environment with a compositor/session stack that must be version-matched.

desktop_sessions.name: Unity
desktop_sessions.notes: Legacy desktop profile; retain as a compatibility target, not a default recommendation.

desktop_sessions.name: Enlightenment
desktop_sessions.notes: Integrated lightweight desktop and compositing environment.

desktop_sessions.name: i3
desktop_sessions.notes: Tiling window manager; requires a separately composed desktop session.

desktop_sessions.name: Sway
desktop_sessions.notes: Wayland compositor and tiling window manager; requires a Wayland host and protocol services.

desktop_sessions.name: AwesomeWM
desktop_sessions.notes: Lua-configurable tiling window manager; not a complete desktop environment.

desktop_sessions.name: Xmonad
desktop_sessions.notes: Tiling window manager; requires an X11 server and user session services.

desktop_sessions.name: Hyprland
desktop_sessions.notes: Wayland compositor with dynamic tiling; requires a compatible Wayland graphics/input backend.

desktop_sessions.name: Openbox
desktop_sessions.notes: Stacking window manager; desktop panels and services are separate components.

desktop_sessions.name: Fluxbox
desktop_sessions.notes: Lightweight stacking window manager; requires an X11 host.

desktop_sessions.name: JWM
desktop_sessions.notes: Small stacking window manager; not a complete desktop environment.

desktop_sessions.name: IceWM
desktop_sessions.notes: Lightweight stacking window manager with a classic desktop workflow.

desktop_sessions.name: Ratpoison
desktop_sessions.notes: Keyboard-driven tiling window manager; requires an X11 host.
